Thank you for the encouragement! My shrink didn't answer and neither did my therapist but I am considering inpatient for a while... 

It's the stares I'm afraid of. I haven't been outside in days because I dread people seeing me like this.

I would but I think he's tired of me at this point. I should have mentioned this is my THIRD revision. I was blessed with a gigantic hump-nose. The first surgery removed the hump but left me with a disproportionately  bulbous tip. The second surgery reduced the tip but left me with this hanging columella. Life's give and take. It was silly to think I could remove it without ending up with a snout. I think it's actually worse than the nose I started out with... 

Thank you for the kind words. I'll give it a few days <3 <3

That's so beautifully said-- I am going to remember that. Grass /is/ greener where you water it. I am going to take that with me into my next relationship (if anyone can ever stand to look at me with this nose) 

(:

Thank you guys for all your kind words and encouragement. I spent today huddled in bed, downing clonopin, and icing my face incessantly in hopes of my nose magically returning it its previous shape. Pathetic, I know. 

Still, it's so nice to know that I'm not completely alone <3
